name: Steamed or salt-fried mantis shrimp
nameVi: Bề bề hấp; bề bề rang muối
summary: Bề bề hấp or rang muối is the whole shrimp, not the noodle bowl. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, names both methods in the Hạ Long seafood meal, and rang muối at the Cái Dăm table.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015. Bún bề bề is the other plate.
howToEat: Steam, or salt-fry. The account does not print a salt mix.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The ordinary seafood meal, and the Cái Dăm table in that account. The live shrimp are also at the market under Núi Bài Thơ, on the 6 May 2020 account.
seoTitle: Be be in Ha Long — steamed or salt-fried
seoDescription: Whole bề bề in Hạ Long is steamed or salt-fried. The noodle bowl is a separate plate. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
